+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Shared text field primitive (prototype-extract.md §6) with the three
+/// border states the project's boundaries fix: default, focused
+/// (`colorPrimary`, 1.5dp) and error (`colorError`, 1.5dp). Consumed by
+/// Story 1.3's login/signup screen.
+class AppTextField extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppTextField({
+    super.key,
+    this.controller,
+    this.labelText,
+    this.hintText,
+    this.errorText,
+    this.obscureText = false,
+    this.keyboardType,
+    this.textInputAction,
+    this.onChanged,
+    this.focusNode,
+    this.maxLines = 1,
+  });
+
+  final TextEditingController? controller;
+  final String? labelText;
+  final String? hintText;
+
+  /// Non-null switches the field to the error border state and shows
+  /// this text below the field (matches `InputDecorator`'s own rule:
+  /// any non-null value, including an empty string, counts as an error).
+  final String? errorText;
+
+  final bool obscureText;
+  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
+  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
+  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
+  final FocusNode? focusNode;
+
+  /// `null` allows unlimited lines (e.g. the insertion modal's "Texto"
+  /// tab); defaults to a single line for form fields like login.
+  final int? maxLines;
+
+  OutlineInputBorder _border(Color color, double width) {
+    return OutlineInputBorder(
+      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+      borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: width),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return TextField(
+      controller: controller,
+      focusNode: focusNode,
+      obscureText: obscureText,
+      keyboardType: keyboardType,
+      textInputAction: textInputAction,
+      onChanged: onChanged,
+      maxLines: obscureText ? 1 : maxLines,
+      minLines: null,
+      style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary),
+      cursorColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+      decoration: InputDecoration(
+        labelText: labelText,
+        hintText: hintText,
+        errorText: errorText,
+        // Unbounded so a long error message wraps instead of being
+        // truncated under Dynamic Type.
+        errorMaxLines: null,
+        filled: true,
+        fillColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
+        contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
+        labelStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        hintStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        errorStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorError),
+        border: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        enabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        focusedBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorPrimary, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        errorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        focusedErrorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        disabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Initials avatar (prototype-extract.md §6): a solid `colorPrimary`
+/// circle with 1–2 uppercase initials, in two sizes — 40dp in the side
+/// menu (Story 1.6), 52dp in Configurações (Epic 8).
+class Avatar extends StatelessWidget {
+  const Avatar({super.key, required this.initials, this.size = AvatarSize.small});
+
+  /// Expected to be 1–2 characters; rendered as given (uppercased) with
+  /// no truncation enforced here — the caller owns deriving initials
+  /// from a name.
+  final String initials;
+
+  final AvatarSize size;
+
+  double get _diameter {
+    switch (size) {
+      case AvatarSize.small:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeSm;
+      case AvatarSize.large:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeLg;
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Container(
+      width: _diameter,
+      height: _diameter,
+      alignment: Alignment.center,
+      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
+        color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+        shape: BoxShape.circle,
+      ),
+      // The circle is a fixed design-token size (not a text container
+      // sized to its content); FittedBox shrinks the initials to fit
+      // under extreme Dynamic Type scales instead of clipping/truncating.
+      child: FittedBox(
+        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
+        child: Padding(
+          padding: DesignTokens.avatarInitialsPadding,
+          child: Text(
+            initials.toUpperCase(),
+            style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary),
+            maxLines: 1,
+            softWrap: false,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+enum AvatarSize { small, large }

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+import 'package:cerne/core/design_tokens.dart';
+import 'package:cerne/core/widgets/app_button.dart';
+
+Widget _wrap(Widget child, {double textScale = 1.0}) {
+  return MediaQuery(
+    data: MediaQueryData(textScaler: TextScaler.linear(textScale)),
+    child: MaterialApp(
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: Center(
+          child: SizedBox(width: 200, child: child),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ),
+  );
+}
+
+ButtonStyleButton _buttonOf(WidgetTester tester) {
+  final elevated = tester.widgetList<ElevatedButton>(find.byType(ElevatedButton));
+  if (elevated.isNotEmpty) return elevated.first;
+  final outlined = tester.widgetList<OutlinedButton>(find.byType(OutlinedButton));
+  if (outlined.isNotEmpty) return outlined.first;
+  return tester.widget<TextButton>(find.byType(TextButton));
+}
+
+void main() {
+  group('AppButton — primary', () {
+    testWidgets('enabled renders colorPrimary background and colorOnPrimary text', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(AppButton(label: 'Entrar', onPressed: () {})));
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester);
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({});
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({});
+      expect(bg, DesignTokens.colorPrimary);
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary);
+
+      final shape = button.style!.shape!.resolve({}) as RoundedRectangleBorder;
+      expect(shape.borderRadius, BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)));
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('pressed overlay resolves to colorPrimaryPressed', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(AppButton(label: 'Entrar', onPressed: () {})));
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester);
+      final overlay = button.style!.overlayColor!.resolve({WidgetState.pressed});
+      expect(overlay, DesignTokens.colorPrimaryPressed);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('disabled renders colorBorder background and colorTextSecondary text, never dimmed opacity', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const AppButton(label: 'Entrar', onPressed: null)));
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester);
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      expect(bg, DesignTokens.colorBorder);
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary);
+      expect(bg!.a, 1.0, reason: 'disabled background must be opaque, not a dimmed/transparent version of another color');
+
+      expect(button.enabled, isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('AppButton — secondaryOutline', () {
+    testWidgets('enabled renders colorPrimary outline, no fill', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(AppButton(label: 'Cancelar', onPressed: () {}, variant: AppButtonVariant.secondaryOutline)),
+      );
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester) as OutlinedButton;
+      final side = button.style!.side!.resolve({});
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({});
+      expect(side!.color, DesignTokens.colorPrimary);
+      expect(bg, Colors.transparent);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('disabled renders colorBorder background and colorTextSecondary text', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(const AppButton(label: 'Cancelar', onPressed: null, variant: AppButtonVariant.secondaryOutline)),
+      );
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester) as OutlinedButton;
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      final side = button.style!.side!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      expect(bg, DesignTokens.colorBorder);
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary);
+      expect(side!.color, DesignTokens.colorBorder);
+      expect(side.width, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('AppButton — textGhost', () {
+    testWidgets('enabled defaults to colorPrimary text, no background', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(AppButton(label: 'Fechar', onPressed: () {}, variant: AppButtonVariant.textGhost)),
+      );

+      final button = _buttonOf(tester) as TextButton;
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({});
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({});
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorPrimary);
+      expect(bg, Colors.transparent);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('honors an explicit contextual text color', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(
+          AppButton(
+            label: 'Limpar',
+            onPressed: () {},
+            variant: AppButtonVariant.textGhost,
+            textColor: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester) as TextButton;
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({});
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('disabled renders colorBorder background and colorTextSecondary text', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(const AppButton(label: 'Fechar', onPressed: null, variant: AppButtonVariant.textGhost)),
+      );
+
+      final button = _buttonOf(tester) as TextButton;
+      final bg = button.style!.backgroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      final fg = button.style!.foregroundColor!.resolve({WidgetState.disabled});
+      expect(bg, DesignTokens.colorBorder);
+      expect(fg, DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('AppButton — Dynamic Type', () {
+    testWidgets('a long label at a large text scale never clips or truncates', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _wrap(
+          AppButton(
+            label: 'Um rótulo de botão bem mais longo do que o normal para testar a quebra de linha',
+            onPressed: () {},
+          ),
+          textScale: 3.0,
+        ),
+      );
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();

+      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);

+      final text = tester.widget<Text>(find.text(

+      expect(text.overflow, isNot(TextOverflow.ellipsis));

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// The three button variants named in prototype-extract.md §6's component
+/// table: primary (filled), secondary (outline), text (ghost).
+enum AppButtonVariant { primary, secondaryOutline, textGhost }
+
+/// Shared button primitive consumed by every feature's `presentation/`
+/// (Story 1.3 login/signup, Story 1.5 overlay, Story 1.6 nav shell).
+///
+/// Disabled state is identical across all three variants, per the
+/// project-wide rule: `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary`
+/// text, never a dimmed-opacity look.
+class AppButton extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppButton({
+    super.key,
+    required this.label,
+    required this.onPressed,
+    this.variant = AppButtonVariant.primary,
+    this.textColor,
+  });
+
+  /// Button label. Rendered with no `maxLines`/`overflow` clamp so it
+  /// wraps rather than clips or truncates under Dynamic Type.
+  final String label;
+
+  /// Null disables the button and switches it to the disabled visual
+  /// state (see class doc).
+  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
+
+  final AppButtonVariant variant;
+
+  /// Only consulted for [AppButtonVariant.textGhost]: the component table
+  /// allows ghost buttons to use either `colorPrimary` or
+  /// `colorTextSecondary` depending on context (e.g. "Fechar"/"Limpar").
+  /// Defaults to `colorPrimary`.
+  final Color? textColor;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final Widget child = Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd);
+
+    final ButtonStyle baseStyle = ButtonStyle(
+      padding: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(DesignTokens.buttonPadding),
+      shape: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(
+        RoundedRectangleBorder(
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+        ),
+      ),
+      elevation: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(0),
+    );
+
+    switch (variant) {
+      case AppButtonVariant.primary:
+        return ElevatedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary;
+            }),
+            overlayColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.pressed)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorPrimaryPressed;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.secondaryOutline:
+        return OutlinedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            side: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorBorder, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+              }
+              return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.textGhost:
+        return TextButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {

+              }
+              return textColor ?? DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );

+  }

+/// Story 1.3's login/signup screen.

+    this.controller,
+    this.labelText,
+    this.hintText,
+    this.errorText,
+    this.obscureText = false,
+    this.keyboardType,
+    this.textInputAction,
+    this.onChanged,
+    this.focusNode,
+    this.maxLines = 1,
+  });

+  final TextEditingController? controller;
+  final String? labelText;
+  final String? hintText;
+
+  /// Non-null switches the field to the error border state and shows
+  /// this text below the field (matches `InputDecorator`'s own rule:
+  /// any non-null value, including an empty string, counts as an error).
+  final String? errorText;
+
+  final bool obscureText;
+  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
+  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
+  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
+  final FocusNode? focusNode;
+
+  /// `null` allows unlimited lines (e.g. the insertion modal's "Texto"
+  /// tab); defaults to a single line for form fields like login.
+  final int? maxLines;
+
+  OutlineInputBorder _border(Color color, double width) {
+    return OutlineInputBorder(
+      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+      borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: width),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return TextField(
+      controller: controller,
+      focusNode: focusNode,
+      obscureText: obscureText,
+      keyboardType: keyboardType,
+      textInputAction: textInputAction,
+      onChanged: onChanged,
+      maxLines: obscureText ? 1 : maxLines,
+      minLines: null,
+      style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary),
+      cursorColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+      decoration: InputDecoration(
+        labelText: labelText,
+        hintText: hintText,
+        errorText: errorText,
+        // Unbounded so a long error message wraps instead of being
+        // truncated under Dynamic Type.
+        errorMaxLines: null,
+        filled: true,
+        fillColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
+        contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
+        labelStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        hintStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        errorStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorError),
+        border: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),

+    expect(border.borderRadius, BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)));
+    expect(decoration.errorText, isNull);

+  testWidgets('focused border is colorPrimary at 1.5dp', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const AppTextField(labelText: 'E-mail')));
+
+    final field = tester.widget<TextField>(find.byType(TextField));
+    final border = _borderOf(field.decoration!.focusedBorder);
+
+    expect(border.borderSide.color, DesignTokens.colorPrimary);
+    expect(border.borderSide.width, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('error state renders a colorError 1.5dp border and the error text', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const AppTextField(labelText: 'Senha', errorText: 'Senha inválida')));
+
+    final field = tester.widget<TextField>(find.byType(TextField));
+    final decoration = field.decoration!;
+
+    expect(decoration.errorText, 'Senha inválida');
+    final errorBorder = _borderOf(decoration.errorBorder);
+    expect(errorBorder.borderSide.color, DesignTokens.colorError);
+    expect(errorBorder.borderSide.width, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis);
+
+    final focusedErrorBorder = _borderOf(decoration.focusedErrorBorder);
+    expect(focusedErrorBorder.borderSide.color, DesignTokens.colorError);
+    expect(focusedErrorBorder.borderSide.width, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a long error message at a large text scale never truncates', (tester) async {
+    const longError =
+        'Esta é uma mensagem de erro bastante longa para verificar que o campo nunca corta ou trunca o texto de erro sob Dynamic Type.';

+    await tester.pumpWidget(
+      _wrap(const AppTextField(labelText: 'E-mail', errorText: longError), textScale: 3.0),

   evidence: `docs/input/requirements.md` fixes the app to a single 390x844 portrait-only frame with no landscape path, but Story 1.1 is core infrastructure only (no screens/app-shell UI) and the architecture spine doesn't assign this lock to any specific story. Likely belongs to Story 1.6 (Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders), the first story that builds real app-shell UI — should be picked up there rather than silently falling through the cracks.

+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-1-2-design-token-system-core-component-library.md`
+  summary: `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart`'s `Avatar` renders raw initials text with no `Semantics` wrapper, so a screen reader announces e.g. "W D" instead of something like "Avatar, Wagner Duarte".
+  evidence: Accessibility semantics were never required by Story 1.2's spec (no boundary, acceptance criterion, or epic-context requirement mentions it) and the prototype gives no guidance either, so adding it now would be scope creep beyond the frozen intent. Worth a deliberate pass across all shared widgets (button/text-field/avatar) once an accessibility requirement exists, rather than bolting it onto one widget ad hoc.

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// The three button variants named in prototype-extract.md §6's component
+/// table: primary (filled), secondary (outline), text (ghost).
+enum AppButtonVariant { primary, secondaryOutline, textGhost }
+
+/// Shared button primitive consumed by every feature's `presentation/`
+/// (Story 1.3 login/signup, Story 1.5 overlay, Story 1.6 nav shell).
+///
+/// Disabled state is identical across all three variants, per the
+/// project-wide rule: `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary`
+/// text, never a dimmed-opacity look.
+class AppButton extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppButton({
+    super.key,
+    required this.label,
+    required this.onPressed,
+    this.variant = AppButtonVariant.primary,
+    this.textColor,
+  });
+
+  /// Button label. Rendered with no `maxLines`/`overflow` clamp so it
+  /// wraps rather than clips or truncates under Dynamic Type.
+  final String label;
+
+  /// Null disables the button and switches it to the disabled visual
+  /// state (see class doc).
+  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
+
+  final AppButtonVariant variant;
+
+  /// Only consulted for [AppButtonVariant.textGhost]: the component table
+  /// allows ghost buttons to use either `colorPrimary` or
+  /// `colorTextSecondary` depending on context (e.g. "Fechar"/"Limpar").
+  /// Defaults to `colorPrimary`.
+  final Color? textColor;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final Widget child = Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd);
+
+    final ButtonStyle baseStyle = ButtonStyle(
+      padding: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(DesignTokens.buttonPadding),
+      shape: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(
+        RoundedRectangleBorder(
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+        ),
+      ),
+      elevation: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(0),
+    );
+
+    switch (variant) {
+      case AppButtonVariant.primary:
+        return ElevatedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary;
+            }),
+            overlayColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.pressed)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorPrimaryPressed;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.secondaryOutline:
+        return OutlinedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            side: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorBorder, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+              }
+              return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.textGhost:
+        return TextButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return textColor ?? DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+    }
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Shared text field primitive (prototype-extract.md §6) with the three
+/// border states the project's boundaries fix: default, focused
+/// (`colorPrimary`, 1.5dp) and error (`colorError`, 1.5dp). Consumed by
+/// Story 1.3's login/signup screen.
+class AppTextField extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppTextField({
+    super.key,
+    this.controller,
+    this.labelText,
+    this.hintText,
+    this.errorText,
+    this.obscureText = false,
+    this.keyboardType,
+    this.textInputAction,
+    this.onChanged,
+    this.focusNode,
+    this.maxLines = 1,
+  });
+
+  final TextEditingController? controller;
+  final String? labelText;
+  final String? hintText;
+
+  /// Non-null switches the field to the error border state and shows
+  /// this text below the field (matches `InputDecorator`'s own rule:
+  /// any non-null value, including an empty string, counts as an error).
+  final String? errorText;
+
+  final bool obscureText;
+  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
+  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
+  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
+  final FocusNode? focusNode;
+
+  /// `null` allows unlimited lines (e.g. the insertion modal's "Texto"
+  /// tab); defaults to a single line for form fields like login.
+  final int? maxLines;
+
+  OutlineInputBorder _border(Color color, double width) {
+    return OutlineInputBorder(
+      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+      borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: width),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return TextField(
+      controller: controller,
+      focusNode: focusNode,
+      obscureText: obscureText,
+      keyboardType: keyboardType,
+      textInputAction: textInputAction,
+      onChanged: onChanged,
+      maxLines: obscureText ? 1 : maxLines,
+      minLines: null,
+      style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary),
+      cursorColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+      decoration: InputDecoration(
+        labelText: labelText,
+        hintText: hintText,
+        errorText: errorText,
+        // Unbounded so a long error message wraps instead of being
+        // truncated under Dynamic Type.
+        errorMaxLines: null,
+        filled: true,
+        fillColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
+        contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
+        labelStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        hintStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        errorStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorError),
+        border: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        enabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        focusedBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorPrimary, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        errorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        focusedErrorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        disabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Initials avatar (prototype-extract.md §6): a solid `colorPrimary`
+/// circle with 1–2 uppercase initials, in two sizes — 40dp in the side
+/// menu (Story 1.6), 52dp in Configurações (Epic 8).
+class Avatar extends StatelessWidget {
+  const Avatar({super.key, required this.initials, this.size = AvatarSize.small});
+
+  /// Expected to be 1–2 characters; rendered as given (uppercased) with
+  /// no truncation enforced here — the caller owns deriving initials
+  /// from a name.
+  final String initials;
+
+  final AvatarSize size;
+
+  double get _diameter {
+    switch (size) {
+      case AvatarSize.small:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeSm;
+      case AvatarSize.large:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeLg;
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Container(
+      width: _diameter,
+      height: _diameter,
+      alignment: Alignment.center,
+      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
+        color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+        shape: BoxShape.circle,
+      ),
+      // The circle is a fixed design-token size (not a text container
+      // sized to its content); FittedBox shrinks the initials to fit
+      // under extreme Dynamic Type scales instead of clipping/truncating.
+      child: FittedBox(
+        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
+        child: Padding(
+          padding: DesignTokens.avatarInitialsPadding,
+          child: Text(
+            initials.toUpperCase(),
+            style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary),
+            maxLines: 1,
+            softWrap: false,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+enum AvatarSize { small, large }

@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// The three button variants named in prototype-extract.md §6's component
+/// table: primary (filled), secondary (outline), text (ghost).
+enum AppButtonVariant { primary, secondaryOutline, textGhost }
+
+/// Shared button primitive consumed by every feature's `presentation/`
+/// (Story 1.3 login/signup, Story 1.5 overlay, Story 1.6 nav shell).
+///
+/// Disabled state is identical across all three variants, per the
+/// project-wide rule: `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary`
+/// text, never a dimmed-opacity look.
+class AppButton extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppButton({
+    super.key,
+    required this.label,
+    required this.onPressed,
+    this.variant = AppButtonVariant.primary,
+    this.textColor,
+  });
+
+  /// Button label. Rendered with no `maxLines`/`overflow` clamp so it
+  /// wraps rather than clips or truncates under Dynamic Type.
+  final String label;
+
+  /// Null disables the button and switches it to the disabled visual
+  /// state (see class doc).
+  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
+
+  final AppButtonVariant variant;
+
+  /// Only consulted for [AppButtonVariant.textGhost]: the component table
+  /// allows ghost buttons to use either `colorPrimary` or
+  /// `colorTextSecondary` depending on context (e.g. "Fechar"/"Limpar").
+  /// Defaults to `colorPrimary`.
+  final Color? textColor;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final Widget child = Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd);
+
+    final ButtonStyle baseStyle = ButtonStyle(
+      padding: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(DesignTokens.buttonPadding),
+      shape: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(
+        RoundedRectangleBorder(
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+        ),
+      ),
+      elevation: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(0),
+    );
+
+    switch (variant) {
+      case AppButtonVariant.primary:
+        return ElevatedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary;
+            }),
+            overlayColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.pressed)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorPrimaryPressed;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.secondaryOutline:
+        return OutlinedButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+            side: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorBorder, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+              }
+              return const BorderSide(color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary, width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault);
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+
+      case AppButtonVariant.textGhost:
+        return TextButton(
+          onPressed: onPressed,
+          style: baseStyle.copyWith(
+            backgroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorBorder;
+              }
+              return Colors.transparent;
+            }),
+            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
+              if (states.contains(WidgetState.disabled)) {
+                return DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary;
+              }
+              return textColor ?? DesignTokens.colorPrimary;
+            }),
+          ),
+          child: child,
+        );
+    }
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Shared text field primitive (prototype-extract.md §6) with the three
+/// border states the project's boundaries fix: default, focused
+/// (`colorPrimary`, 1.5dp) and error (`colorError`, 1.5dp). Consumed by
+/// Story 1.3's login/signup screen.
+class AppTextField extends StatelessWidget {
+  const AppTextField({
+    super.key,
+    this.controller,
+    this.labelText,
+    this.hintText,
+    this.errorText,
+    this.obscureText = false,
+    this.keyboardType,
+    this.textInputAction,
+    this.onChanged,
+    this.focusNode,
+    this.maxLines = 1,
+  });
+
+  final TextEditingController? controller;
+  final String? labelText;
+  final String? hintText;
+
+  /// Non-null switches the field to the error border state and shows
+  /// this text below the field (matches `InputDecorator`'s own rule:
+  /// any non-null value, including an empty string, counts as an error).
+  final String? errorText;
+
+  final bool obscureText;
+  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
+  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
+  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
+  final FocusNode? focusNode;
+
+  /// `null` allows unlimited lines (e.g. the insertion modal's "Texto"
+  /// tab); defaults to a single line for form fields like login.
+  final int? maxLines;
+
+  OutlineInputBorder _border(Color color, double width) {
+    return OutlineInputBorder(
+      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm)),
+      borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: width),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return TextField(
+      controller: controller,
+      focusNode: focusNode,
+      obscureText: obscureText,
+      keyboardType: keyboardType,
+      textInputAction: textInputAction,
+      onChanged: onChanged,
+      maxLines: obscureText ? 1 : maxLines,
+      minLines: null,
+      style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary),
+      cursorColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+      decoration: InputDecoration(
+        labelText: labelText,
+        hintText: hintText,
+        errorText: errorText,
+        // Unbounded so a long error message wraps instead of being
+        // truncated under Dynamic Type.
+        errorMaxLines: null,
+        filled: true,
+        fillColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
+        contentPadding: DesignTokens.textFieldContentPadding,
+        labelStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        hintStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
+        errorStyle: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorError),
+        border: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        enabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+        focusedBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorPrimary, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        errorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        focusedErrorBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorError, DesignTokens.borderWidthEmphasis),
+        disabledBorder: _border(DesignTokens.colorBorder, DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../design_tokens.dart';
+
+/// Initials avatar (prototype-extract.md §6): a solid `colorPrimary`
+/// circle with 1–2 uppercase initials, in two sizes — 40dp in the side
+/// menu (Story 1.6), 52dp in Configurações (Epic 8).
+class Avatar extends StatelessWidget {
+  const Avatar({super.key, required this.initials, this.size = AvatarSize.small});
+
+  /// Expected to be 1–2 characters; rendered as given (uppercased) with
+  /// no truncation enforced here — the caller owns deriving initials
+  /// from a name.
+  final String initials;
+
+  final AvatarSize size;
+
+  double get _diameter {
+    switch (size) {
+      case AvatarSize.small:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeSm;
+      case AvatarSize.large:
+        return DesignTokens.avatarSizeLg;
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Container(
+      width: _diameter,
+      height: _diameter,
+      alignment: Alignment.center,
+      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
+        color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
+        shape: BoxShape.circle,
+      ),
+      // The circle is a fixed design-token size (not a text container
+      // sized to its content); FittedBox shrinks the initials to fit
+      // under extreme Dynamic Type scales instead of clipping/truncating.
+      child: FittedBox(
+        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
+        child: Padding(
+          padding: DesignTokens.avatarInitialsPadding,
+          child: Text(
+            initials.toUpperCase(),
+            style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary),
+            maxLines: 1,
+            softWrap: false,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+enum AvatarSize { small, large }

# Step 3: Triage

## RULES

- YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK OUTPUT in your Agent communication style with the config `{communication_language}`

## INSTRUCTIONS

1. **Normalize** findings from all layers into a unified list where each finding has:
   - `id` -- sequential integer
   - `source` -- the `id` of the layer that produced the finding (e.g., `blind-hunter`), or merged sources joined with `+` (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`)
   - `title` -- one-line summary
   - `detail` -- full description
   - `location` -- file and line reference (if available)

2. **Deduplicate.** Deduplicate only findings with the same claim and same required action. If two or more findings meet both conditions, merge them into one:
   - Use the most specific finding as the base (prefer findings with a precise location over prose-only findings).
   - Append any unique detail, reasoning, or location references from the other finding(s) into the surviving `detail` field.
   - Set `source` to the merged sources (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`).

3. Then evaluate each remaining finding independently. Do not reject a finding because a related finding was rejected.

4. **Read the code before rating.** Before assigning severity, open the source at each finding's location and read enough surrounding code to judge reachability -- call sites, guards, and validation that live outside the diff hunk. Do not rate from the diff hunk alone. Severity reflects the real consequence at a real call site, not the worst theoretical reading.

5. **Assign severity** to each finding by consequence for the artifact's main consumer (software user, document reader, etc).
   Disregard any severity assigned by a reviewing subagent. Review subagents operate under by-design information asymmetry and do not have enough context to set final severity for this workflow.
   - `low` -- none or cosmetic
   - `medium` -- tolerable
   - `high` -- intolerable

6. **Route** each finding into exactly one triage bucket:
   - **decision_needed** -- There is an ambiguous choice that requires human input. The code cannot be correctly patched without knowing the user's intent. Only possible if `{review_mode}` = `"full"`.
   - **patch** -- Code issue that is fixable without human input. The correct fix is unambiguous.
   - **defer** -- Pre-existing issue not caused by the current change. Real but not actionable now.
   - **dismiss** -- Noise, false positive, or handled elsewhere.

   If `{review_mode}` = `"no-spec"` and a finding would otherwise be `decision_needed`, reclassify it as `patch` (if the fix is unambiguous) or `defer` (if not).

7. **Drop** all `dismiss` findings. Record the dismiss count for the summary.

8. If `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, report which layers failed before announcing results. If zero findings remain after dropping dismissed AND `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, warn the user that the review may be incomplete rather than announcing a clean review.

9. If zero findings remain after triage (all rejected or none raised): state "✅ Clean review — all layers passed." (Step 3 already warned if any review layers failed via `{failed_layers}`.)

## Deferred from: code review of story-1-2-design-token-system-core-component-library (2026-10-27)

- `AppButton` has no loading/busy state, even though most of its real call sites (login submit, insertion-modal "Salvar", export actions) are async network calls. Not required by Story 1.2's boundaries (§6's button component table lists only normal/pressed/disabled variations) — pick up when the first async-submit screen (Story 1.3) needs it, rather than letting each feature improvise its own busy treatment.
- `AppTextField` exposes no `enabled`/`readOnly`, `onSubmitted`, `autofocus`, `textCapitalization`, or `inputFormatters` — all plausible needs for the upcoming login/signup and inline-name-edit screens. Not required by Story 1.2's acceptance criteria; let Story 1.3 (its first real consumer) request exactly what it needs instead of speculatively widening the shared primitive now.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` now imports `package:flutter/widgets.dart` (needed for `Color`/`TextStyle`/`EdgeInsets`/`BoxShadow`), but nothing in the repo (lint rule or architecture test) would catch a future `domain/` layer importing it for a color/style constant, which would transitively violate RNF06. No domain code exists yet to violate this, so it's not a bug today — worth a lint rule or architecture test once the first feature's `domain/` layer is scaffolded.
